name: Split text
summary: A word cut into top and bottom halves that slide apart and rejoin, for glitchy-smooth transitions and title stingers.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: size
params.note: font size; shrinks to fit 980 px

params.name: dur
params.note: frames for the halves to part and rejoin

params.name: seed
params.note: unique id prefix for the clip paths

author: krakujs
